title: Approve the SubTrack MVP1 proposal
summary: Review the Plan in the right sidebar, then select the hires and follow-up tasks to authorize.

payload.prompt: Approve the SubTrack plan and select what I should create next.
payload.detailsMarkdown: The Plan in the right sidebar names the product **SubTrack** and captures the MVP scope, guardrails, team, and work sequence.

options.label: Hire CTO
options.description: Technical Lead — architecture, Tink/provider abstraction, security, deployment, and observability.

options.label: Hire Product Designer
options.description: Product & UX — user stories, acceptance criteria, mobile-first flows, and household privacy behavior.

options.label: Hire Founding Engineer
options.description: Full-stack — implement the approved architecture and end-to-end MVP.

options.label: Hire QA & Security Engineer
options.description: Quality and privacy — financial, integration, E2E, security, and privacy testing.

options.label: Task: Architecture & Tink discovery
options.description: Validate stack, current Sandbox capabilities, provider contracts, data model, controls, and milestones.

options.label: Task: Product & UX specification
options.description: Define prioritized stories, acceptance criteria, flows, screens, and privacy behavior.

options.label: Task: Engineering foundation
options.description: Set up application, database, auth, CI, provider abstraction, fixtures, audit, and consent.

options.label: Task: Core individual experience
options.description: Build ingestion, normalization, detection, review/correction, subscriptions, and dashboard.

options.label: Task: Household value loop
options.description: Build household membership, sharing, splits, settlement, and completion tracking.

options.label: Task: AI insights & hardening
options.description: Add explainable insights, privacy controls, observability, security, and E2E verification.
